title: Mass Marketing — Overview
summary: Treating the whole market as one segment with a single offer.
body:
Treating the whole market as one segment with a single offer. The traditional Henry Ford-era approach.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include Targeting Strategies, Niche Marketing, Commoditization.
